answer_1.quote: For our main experiments, we use LLaMA-2-7B to generate sequences using the newslike subset of the Colossal Common Crawl Cleaned corpus (C4) dataset following previous work . This simulates the scenario of generating fake news given a certain topic.

answer_2.quote: Metrics To measure the performance of multi-bit watermarking, we use bit accuracy... For zero-bit watermark performance... we use area under the ROC curve (AUROC) and the true positive rate (TPR)... Text quality is measured by perplexity (PPL) and semantic similarity based on a paraphraser model.
